run_dlrm_training: run the DLRM recommendation model training loop with configurable MLP layers, embeddings, and loss functions via argparse CLI
run_dlrm_inference: run the DLRM model in inference-only mode to generate predictions without computing gradients or loss
create_dlrm_net: create a DLRM_Net instance with configurable sparse feature size, embedding sizes, bottom and top MLP layer dimensions
create_dlrm_mlp: create an MLP subgraph with fully connected layers and configurable ReLU or Sigmoid activation functions
export_dlrm_onnx: export the trained DLRM Caffe2 model to ONNX format for cross-framework interoperability
